Dear Sirs, 
 
 
Sub.:  Audio recording of Q1 / FY27 Earnings Call  
 
 
Further to our letter dated July 17, 2026, wherein we had informed about the             
Q1 / FY27 earnings call and pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 read with clause 15 
of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby confirm that we have uploaded 
audio recording of the Q1 / FY27 Earnings Call held on Tuesday, July 28, 2026 
on our  website https://investors.larsentoubro.com/Transcripts-Archives.aspx
